knowledge_gaps: Preserving tokens does not preserve attribute relationships: mean pooling loses order and bindings between model identifiers, connectors, dimensions and negations. Compatibility gains remain speculative.

Reproduction requires explicit vocabulary limits, tokenization, truncation, encoder dimensions, fusion scaling, initialization, optimizer settings and checkpoint selection rules. Missing text must yield zero even when the projection has a bias.

No baseline validation HR@10 or paired comparison is reported. Training margins cannot establish Electronics as the category with greatest validation improvement potential. Repeated selection on 200 users/category risks validation overfitting.

The plan omits training and full-catalog scoring costs within the shared GPU budget. Learned text representations must retain gradients during training; inference caches must match the selected checkpoint.

Originality is modest because ID-plus-text fusion is established. Potential and implementation difficulty scores are subjective; scratch-trained text effectiveness, metadata coverage and predictor integration remain unresolved.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether the proposed pooling can support the claimed specificity and whether a small jointly trained alternative deserves comparison.
follow_up_queries.query: In sequential recommendation with randomly initialized text embeddings and no pretrained weights, what evidence compares mean-pooled title/description encoders with small CNN or order-aware encoders for preserving product model numbers, units, negation and compatibility attributes? Include ID-plus-text fusion ablations and sparse-metadata limitations.

follow_up_queries.reason: Separate useful semantic transfer from added capacity or shortcuts, and make the implementation reproducible within one HSTU model per category.
follow_up_queries.query: For jointly trained ID-plus-text HSTU recommendation without pretrained encoders, what fusion scaling, normalization, vocabulary construction, truncation and missing-text handling are supported by published implementations? What parameter-matched ID-only and shuffled item-text ablations test whether gains reflect meaningful text alignment rather than capacity, popularity or brand shortcuts?

follow_up_queries.reason: Establish a defensible validation and compute plan without changing the pinned evaluator or accessing test labels.
follow_up_queries.query: For sequential recommendation evaluated by HR@10 on 200 fixed users per category with 99 sampled negatives, what methods quantify paired baseline-versus-model uncertainty and repeated-validation selection bias? How should a prespecified text-fusion ablation and checkpoint schedule account for a fixed GPU budget and distinguish sampled-candidate accuracy from full-catalog recommendation quality?
